(ax) “Regulations” means the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018, unless otherwise indicated; (ay) “Regulatory Sandbox” means specifically constructed experimental space, with a safe environment, within which various stakeholders can use Regulatory Technology solutions to develop and refine Code(s) of Practice to comply with new regulatory requirements; (az) “Relationship” means a prior or existing relationship (iii) for business or commercial reasons, between a person or entity and a subscriber with or without an exchange of consideration, (iv) on the basis of the purchase or transaction made by or done by the recipient with the sender within the tweleve months immediately preceding the date of the communication; or (v) on the basis of inquiry or application regarding products or services
title: 09 draft commercial communications
